title: Removal of the Fwd Cargo Door Latch Pins and Housing Bushings
abstract: Removal of the eight latch pins of the forward cargo door and of the bushings pressed into their housings, with the mechanism locked at the unlocked stop throughout.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the eight latch pins of the forward cargo door and to press the bushings out of the latch pin housings.
sections.job_setup_note: The latch mechanism must be driven by hand to the unlocked stop and locked there with the locking pin before any fastener is disturbed. Do not use the door actuation system to position the mechanism. The door must be open on its maintenance stay and the compartment must be empty. One person can do the pin removal but a second is needed at the press stage to hold the arbor square to the bore.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the forward cargo door and install the maintenance stay. 2. De-energise and isolate the door actuation system. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE DOOR ACTUATION SYSTEM IS ISOLATED BEFORE YOU TOUCH THE LATCH MECHANISM. THE LATCH HOOKS CAN CLOSE WITH SUFFICIENT FORCE TO REMOVE A FINGER. 3. Drive the latch mechanism by hand to the unlocked stop and install the locking pin. 4. Get access to the latch beam through the openings in zones 891 and 893. 5. Remove the retention plate D5230135480243 at each end of the latch beam. 6. Remove the split pin and the retaining nut from the first latch pin and push the pin clear of the housing. 7. Do step 6 again for the other seven latch pins. 8. Wipe the old grease out of each housing bore and off each pin with the aqueous cleaning agent, and work the residue out of the bore with a lint-free swab until the bore is dry to the touch. 9. Set the press arbor square to the first housing bore. CAUTION: DO NOT PRESS AGAINST THE DOUBLER FLANGE. THE FLANGE IS THIN AND WILL DEFORM UNDER THE ARBOR LOAD. 10. Press the bushing out of the housing and collect it. 11. Do steps 9 and 10 again for the other seven housings. 12. Clean each bore and do a detailed visual inspection for scoring and for fretting at the doubler D5230134342244. 13. Apply a light film of the approved grease to each bore to protect it while the housing is open.
sections.close_out: Identify the removed pins by position and keep them for the condition assessment. Put a protective plug in each open bore. Make sure that the grease film applied at step 13 is unbroken and that no tool is left on the latch beam. Confirm that the locking pin is still installed. Record the bore condition and any fretting finding on the aircraft work card.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The housings carry greased bronze bushings and the degreasing and re-greasing steps apply throughout.

safety_precautions: Isolate and de-energise the cargo door actuation system.
Install the latch mechanism locking pin before any work on the latch beam.
Put the warning notices in position at the door control panel.

title: Removal of the Fwd Cargo Door Latch Pins and Housing Bushings

issue.reason: Degreasing and re-greasing steps placed under a pre-modification effectivity condition and a caution added against lubricating a self-lubricating liner.

abstract: Removal of the eight latch pins of the forward cargo door and of the bushings pressed into their housings, with the mechanism locked at the unlocked stop throughout.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the eight latch pins of the forward cargo door and to press the bushings out of the latch pin housings.
sections.job_setup_note: Establish the bushing standard from the aircraft configuration record before you start. The greased bronze bushing and the self-lubricating liner are removed the same way but are not prepared the same way, and the lubrication steps of this task apply to one of them only. The latch mechanism must be driven by hand to the unlocked stop and locked there with the locking pin before any fastener is disturbed. Do not use the door actuation system to position the mechanism. The door must be open on its maintenance stay and the compartment must be empty. One person can do the pin removal but a second is needed at the press stage to hold the arbor square to the bore.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the forward cargo door and install the maintenance stay. 2. De-energise and isolate the door actuation system. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE DOOR ACTUATION SYSTEM IS ISOLATED BEFORE YOU TOUCH THE LATCH MECHANISM. THE LATCH HOOKS CAN CLOSE WITH SUFFICIENT FORCE TO REMOVE A FINGER. 3. Drive the latch mechanism by hand to the unlocked stop and install the locking pin. 4. Get access to the latch beam through the openings in zones 891 and 893. 5. Remove the retention plate D5230135480243 at each end of the latch beam. 6. Remove the split pin and the retaining nut from the first latch pin and push the pin clear of the housing. 7. Do step 6 again for the other seven latch pins. 8. PRE MOD-160915 AIRCRAFT ONLY: wipe the old grease out of each housing bore and off each pin with the aqueous cleaning agent, and work the residue out of the bore with a lint-free swab until the bore is dry to the touch. CAUTION: DO NOT DO STEP 8 ON A POST MOD-160915 AIRCRAFT. THE SELF-LUBRICATING LINER CARRIES A DRY TRANSFER FILM THAT IS PART OF THE BEARING SURFACE, AND SOLVENT OR AQUEOUS CLEANING REMOVES IT. 9. Set the press arbor square to the first housing bore. CAUTION: DO NOT PRESS AGAINST THE DOUBLER FLANGE. THE FLANGE IS THIN AND WILL DEFORM UNDER THE ARBOR LOAD. 10. Press the bushing out of the housing and collect it, using the lower press load of the liner table on a post MOD-160915 aircraft. 11. Do steps 9 and 10 again for the other seven housings. 12. Clean each bore and do a detailed visual inspection for scoring and for fretting at the doubler D5230134342244. 13. PRE MOD-160915 AIRCRAFT ONLY: apply a light film of the approved grease to each bore to protect it while the housing is open. On a post MOD-160915 aircraft leave the bore dry and fit the protective plug immediately.
sections.close_out: Identify the removed pins by position and keep them for the condition assessment. Put a protective plug in each open bore. On a pre MOD-160915 aircraft make sure that the grease film applied at step 13 is unbroken; on a post MOD-160915 aircraft record on the work card that the bore was left dry, because a greased liner bore has to be stripped and the liner renewed. Make sure that no tool is left on the latch beam and that the locking pin is still installed. Record the bore condition and any fretting finding on the aircraft work card.

type_data.effectivity_note: Pre MOD-160915 aircraft carry greased bronze bushings: steps 8 and 13 apply and the standard press load table is used. Post MOD-160915 aircraft carry self-lubricating liners: steps 8 and 13 must not be done, no cleaning agent or grease may reach the bore, and the lower press load of the liner table applies.

safety_precautions: Isolate and de-energise the cargo door actuation system.
Install the latch mechanism locking pin before any work on the latch beam.
Put the warning notices in position at the door control panel.
